name: WAHA (WhatsApp HTTP API)
description: Let your AI use a WhatsApp account through your own WAHA server, the self-hosted open-source WhatsApp HTTP API: read chats, messages, contacts and groups, check numbers, and send text, images and files. Unofficial gateway; for Meta's official API use WhatsApp Business Cloud API.
instructions:
> **Status (Nov 2026): taken out of the store.** This connector drives WhatsApp through an unofficial, self-hosted gateway. WhatsApp's terms do not allow unofficial clients and can lead to a banned number, so it is no longer offered in the catalog. Use the official **WhatsApp Business Cloud API** connector (`whatsapp-business`) instead. The adapter is kept and still resolvable by slug, so connectors installed earlier keep working.

## WAHA (WhatsApp HTTP API)
This connector talks to a **WAHA** server (WhatsApp HTTP API by devlike.pro), an open-source gateway that you host yourself and that drives a normal WhatsApp or WhatsApp Business account through WhatsApp Web: sessions, chats and messages, contacts, groups, and sending text, images and files.

**Unofficial gateway, read this first.** WAHA is not a Meta product. It automates a personal or business WhatsApp account that you link by QR code, the way WhatsApp Web does. WhatsApp does not support this and can limit or ban numbers that send automated or unsolicited messages. The official route is the **WhatsApp Business Cloud API** connector in this catalog (Meta's API, with approved templates). Use WAHA only with a number you own, for conversations people expect, and at a human pace.

**Setup (about 10 minutes, you run the server)**
1. Run WAHA, for example with Docker (`devlikeapro/waha`), following https://waha.devlike.pro/docs/overview/quick-start/. On AnythingMCP Cloud the server must be reachable from the internet over HTTPS; a self-hosted AnythingMCP can reach it on the local network.
2. Set an API key in WAHA (environment variable `WAHA_API_KEY`) and restart it. Recent versions print a generated key in the start-up log when none is set. Never run WAHA on the internet without a key: anyone could read and send your WhatsApp messages.
3. Open the WAHA dashboard (`/dashboard`), start the session `default` and scan the QR code with WhatsApp on the phone (Linked devices). The session must show **WORKING**.
4. Fill in `WAHA_URL` (the address of the server, without `/api`) and `WAHA_API_KEY`. `WAHA_SESSION` is only needed when your session is not called `default` (WAHA Plus allows several).

**Where to start**: `waha_list_sessions` shows whether the session is WORKING (`waha_get_session` and `waha_get_account` give the details and the own number). `waha_get_chats_overview` lists the latest conversations; `waha_list_chat_messages` reads one of them.

**Reading**: `waha_list_chats`, `waha_get_chats_overview`, `waha_list_chat_messages`, `waha_get_message`, `waha_list_contacts`, `waha_get_contact`, `waha_check_number_exists`, `waha_list_groups`, `waha_get_group`, `waha_list_group_participants`.

**Writing**: `waha_send_text`, `waha_send_image` and `waha_send_file` (media by URL), `waha_react_to_message`, `waha_edit_message`, `waha_delete_message` (switched off at install), `waha_send_seen` (marks as read), `waha_start_typing` and `waha_stop_typing`. Every send leaves at once from the linked phone number: confirm the recipient and the text with the user.

**Field notes**
- Chat ids: a person is `<number>@c.us` with the number in international format without `+` (Germany 49..., Italy 39...); a group ends in `@g.us`, a channel in `@newsletter`. WhatsApp increasingly returns `@lid` ids that hide the phone number: pass them back exactly as received.
- Unknown numbers: call `waha_check_number_exists` and write to the `chatId` it returns.
- Message ids look like `false_4915112345678@c.us_3EB0...`; the first part is `true` for messages the account sent.
- Timestamps are Unix seconds. `ack` states: PENDING, SERVER (one tick), DEVICE (two ticks), READ (blue ticks), PLAYED.
- Only what the session has synced is readable: history from before the phone was linked may be missing, depending on the engine (WEBJS, NOWEB or GOWS) and its store settings.
- A call on a session that is not WORKING answers 422. Open the WAHA dashboard, restart the session or scan the QR code again.
- Some features (several sessions, sending media on older versions, some engines) depend on the WAHA edition. A 422 or 501 with a message about the engine or the Plus version means the server cannot do that.
- Pace: wait a few seconds between messages and do not write to people who never contacted the number; that is what gets numbers banned.
prerequisites: Your own WAHA server (self-hosted, e.g. with Docker) with an API key set, reachable from AnythingMCP (on Cloud: public over HTTPS), and a WhatsApp account linked to it by QR code. WAHA is an unofficial gateway; the official route is the WhatsApp Business Cloud API connector.

WAHA_URL.label: WAHA server address
WAHA_URL.help: The address of your WAHA server, without /api and without a trailing slash. On AnythingMCP Cloud it must be public over HTTPS.
WAHA_URL.patternMessage: Enter the full address starting with https:// or http://, without /api and without a trailing slash, e.g. https://waha.example.com or http://192.168.1.10:3000.

WAHA_API_KEY.label: API key
WAHA_API_KEY.help: The key your WAHA server was started with (environment variable WAHA_API_KEY, or the key printed in its start-up log). Set one before exposing WAHA.
WAHA_API_KEY.patternMessage: Paste the API key without spaces.

WAHA_SESSION.label: Session name
WAHA_SESSION.help: Only when your WhatsApp session in WAHA is not called default. Leave empty otherwise.
WAHA_SESSION.patternMessage: Use the session name as shown in the WAHA dashboard: letters, digits, dashes and underscores.

instructionFacts: This workspace uses the WAHA session {{WAHA_SESSION}}; the tools use it by themselves when session is left out.

verifyHints.401: WAHA refused the API key. Use the key the server was started with (WAHA_API_KEY in its environment, or the one in its start-up log).
verifyHints.404: Nothing answered at this path. Check WAHA_URL (the server address without /api) and that the session name exists.
verifyHints.422: The WhatsApp session is not ready. Open the WAHA dashboard, start the session and scan the QR code until it shows WORKING.
verifyHints.unreachable: The WAHA server did not answer. Check WAHA_URL and that the server is running; on AnythingMCP Cloud it must be reachable from the internet over HTTPS.

tools.name: waha_list_sessions
tools.description: List the WhatsApp sessions of this WAHA server: name, status (STOPPED, STARTING, SCAN_QR_CODE, WORKING, FAILED), me (id and pushName of the linked account) and config. A session must be WORKING before chats can be read or messages sent. Read-only.

tools.name: waha_get_session
tools.description: Read one session: status (STOPPED, STARTING, SCAN_QR_CODE, WORKING, FAILED), the linked account (me.id, me.pushName), the engine and its configuration such as webhooks. SCAN_QR_CODE means the phone still has to be linked in the WAHA dashboard. Read-only.

session.description: WAHA session (the linked WhatsApp account). Leave out to use the connector's session, which is `default` unless another one was configured.

tools.name: waha_get_account
tools.description: Read the WhatsApp account linked to a session: id (the own number as a chat id), lid, pushName and, when WhatsApp reported them, reach-out restrictions. Read-only.

session.description: WAHA session (the linked WhatsApp account). Leave out to use the connector's session, which is `default` unless another one was configured.

tools.name: waha_list_chats
tools.description: List the chats of the linked account (people, groups, channels) as the WhatsApp engine stores them: id, name and the time of the last message, with engine-specific fields. For names and last messages in one answer use waha_get_chats_overview. Read-only; page with limit and offset.

session.description: WAHA session (the linked WhatsApp account). Leave out to use the connector's session, which is `default` unless another one was configured.

sort_by.description: Sort by conversationTimestamp (last activity), id or name.

offset.description: How many to skip, for paging.

tools.name: waha_get_chats_overview
tools.description: List chats the way the WhatsApp start screen shows them, most recent first: id, name, picture and lastMessage (text, time, sender, delivery state). The quickest way to see who wrote last. Read-only; page with limit and offset.

session.description: WAHA session (the linked WhatsApp account). Leave out to use the connector's session, which is `default` unless another one was configured.

offset.description: How many to skip, for paging.

tools.name: waha_list_chat_messages
tools.description: Read the messages of one chat, newest first: id, timestamp (Unix seconds), from, fromMe, participant (the sender in a group), body (the text), hasMedia with media details, ack and ackName (PENDING, SERVER, DEVICE, READ, PLAYED) and replyTo. Only messages the session has synced are available. Read-only; page with limit and offset.

session.description: WAHA session (the linked WhatsApp account). Leave out to use the connector's session, which is `default` unless another one was configured.

chat_id.description: Chat id: the phone number in international format without + followed by @c.us for a person (e.g. 4915112345678@c.us), an id ending in @g.us for a group, @newsletter for a channel, or an @lid id exactly as WAHA returned it.

limit.description: How many to return (default 20, at most 100).

offset.description: How many to skip, for paging.

from_timestamp.description: Only messages at or after this moment, Unix time in seconds.

to_timestamp.description: Only messages at or before this moment, Unix time in seconds.

from_me.description: true only messages the linked account sent, false only received ones.

download_media.description: true makes WAHA download attached media and return a link to each file. Slower; leave false to read text.

tools.name: waha_get_message
tools.description: Read one message of a chat by its id: timestamp, from, fromMe, body, media details, ack state and the quoted message. Read-only.

chat_id.description: Chat id: the phone number in international format without + followed by @c.us for a person (e.g. 4915112345678@c.us), an id ending in @g.us for a group, @newsletter for a channel, or an @lid id exactly as WAHA returned it.

message_id.description: Id of the message, exactly as WAHA returned it (e.g. false_4915112345678@c.us_3EB0A1B2C3D4E5F6A7B8).

download_media.description: true makes WAHA download the attached media and return a link to the file.

tools.name: waha_send_text
tools.description: Send a WhatsApp text message from the linked account to a person or group. Returns the sent message with its id. The message leaves at once and is seen as coming from that phone number, so confirm the text and the recipient with the user first. Check an unknown number with waha_check_number_exists before writing to it.

session.description: WAHA session (the linked WhatsApp account). Leave out to use the connector's session, which is `default` unless another one was configured.

chat_id.description: Recipient chat id: the phone number in international format without + followed by @c.us for a person (e.g. 4915112345678@c.us), an id ending in @g.us for a group, @newsletter for a channel, or an @lid id exactly as WAHA returned it.

reply_to.description: Id of a message to quote as a reply, as WAHA returned it.

link_preview.description: false sends links without a preview (default true).

mentions.description: Group members to mention, as chat ids ending in @c.us; the text must contain @ followed by the number.

tools.name: waha_send_image
tools.description: Send an image from a URL as a WhatsApp message, with an optional caption. WAHA downloads the file from the URL, so it must be reachable from the WAHA server. Returns the sent message. Leaves at once, so confirm with the user. Sending media needs a WAHA edition and engine that support it.

file_url.description: URL of the image (JPEG or PNG).

filename.description: File name shown to the recipient, e.g. photo.jpg.

tools.name: waha_send_file
tools.description: Send a document (PDF, spreadsheet, archive, any file) from a URL as a WhatsApp message, with an optional caption. WAHA downloads the file from the URL, so it must be reachable from the WAHA server. Returns the sent message. Leaves at once, so confirm with the user.

tools.description: Check whether a phone number is registered on WhatsApp: numberExists (true or false) and chatId, the id to write to. Always use the returned chatId, because WhatsApp rewrites some national numbers (Brazil, Mexico, Argentina). Read-only.
